properties.description: Three real-binary tests with an isolated HOME. The walk: stdio, --http and --serve-shared, each in an empty folder and an opted-in one, started with --read-only: the handshake says there is no design store and why, the latent tools are listed, reflow2_start_design is refused naming --read-only, describe_designs answers, /readyz says 503 over HTTP, and the folder stays byte-identical; then another process creates the store, and the same session reads it, has its write refused READ-ONLY, /readyz says 200, no rendezvous is left and the write never lands. --only-if-present over stdio and --http with --export-to: served on the transport asked, and the design it starts keeps the export current. The registry pin: --registry-root --read-only creates nothing under an empty root and serves a design that appears there read-only (passes on main by construction).
properties.name: a_read_only_server_with_no_store_serves_the_latent_surface.rs — every serving mode, --read-only, no store: latent surface, nothing created
